verdict.rationale: Auth0's own docs point to code-level building: framework integrations for agents (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Cloudflare Agents, Vercel AI SDK, Genkit), step-by-step quickstarts per application type, and agent security in "just a few lines of code." A community commenter also praises Auth0's well-maintained open source packages. However, no evidence explicitly names or documents official SDKs, their languages, or their API coverage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and supported languages/platforms, SDK API reference depth, hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
